channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Após visitar Bolsonaro, Carlos diz que PL irá apoiar Alfredo Gaspar e Arthur Lira ao Senado em AL
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro announced that, after visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest, his father defined the PL’s support for Alfredo Gaspar (PL) and Arthur Lira (PP) as Senate candidates in Alagoas for the 2026 elections. The two are competing for the two open seats currently held by Renan Calheiros and Fernando Farias (both MDB), whose terms end in January 2027. Lira remains affiliated with the PP but is in talks to join the PL, while Gaspar is already the state president of the PL in Alagoas after leaving União Brasil.

item.title: A reação bolsonarista com a convocação de Neymar para Copa do Mundo de 2026
item.description: Bolsonarists celebrated Neymar's call-up for the 2026 World Cup, interpreting it as a sign that Brazil could win the hexacampionship. Figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, Nikolas Ferreira, and Guilherme Derrite praised the player, linking his presence to hopes of victory and using the event to mobilize political support.

item.title: Petrobras deve cuidar para não “tirar japonesinho” do pré-sal, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva joked during a Petrobras ceremony about the risk of over-drilling in deep waters, saying they must not 'take out a little Japanese' when drilling from Mexico, despite the antipode of Mexico being in the Indian Ocean, not Japan. He also stated that Petrobras will assist Pemex in exploring oil at depths of 2,000 to 3,000 meters, following a meeting between the two companies' presidents in late April.

item.title: 'Terminou a novela' do Neymar: como imprensa internacional repercutiu convocação da Seleção Brasileira
item.description: International press highlighted Neymar's inclusion in Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad after months of uncertainty, with Argentine outlet Olé declaring the 'novela' over his selection had ended. Spanish media like Marca emphasized that this will be Carlo Ancelotti's first World Cup as Brazil's head coach, while The New York Times noted the domestic debate over Neymar's call-up and criticized the omission of João Pedro. Despite recent scrutiny, global outlets maintained Brazil as a tournament favorite.

item.title: Lindbergh pede inclusão de Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro em inquérito que investiga Eduardo por coação nos EUA
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) urged the Supreme Federal Court to include Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former President Jair Bolsonaro in the investigation probing Eduardo Bolsonaro for alleged coercion in the U.S., claiming the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' may have served as a financial mechanism to support external campaigns against Brazil. He also requested precautionary measures against Flávio Bolsonaro, such as passport surrender and travel restrictions, and an expansion of the inquiry to examine financial ties with Daniel Vorcaro, former CEO of Banco Master.

item.title: STF descarta ação contra ‘espionagem’ em redes de jornalistas e parlamentares no governo Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) ruled against a lawsuit filed by the Green Party alleging that the Bolsonaro government conducted espionage against journalists and legislators via social media monitoring reports produced by a private company. By a 7-4 vote, the justices determined the action did not constitute espionage and that an ADPF was not the appropriate legal mechanism, as the matter involved a concrete act better suited for a popular action. The ruling concluded a case that had been pending since 2022, with repeated delays in both virtual and in-person plenary sessions.

item.title: Lula vai a hospital em São Paulo para acompanhamento de procedimentos feitos em abril
item.description: President Lula (PT) underwent a routine check-up at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo to monitor medical procedures performed in April, including the removal of a skin lesion on his scalp and a wrist injection for tendonitis. According to the medical bulletin, his recovery is progressing satisfactorily with no complications, and he has resumed his normal activities, including attending a construction industry fair and launching the Move Aplicativos credit line for app-based drivers and taxi workers.

item.title: Lula faz exames em SP e evolução pós-tratamentos é satisfatória
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent medical follow-up exams at the Sirio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo on May 18, 2026, after procedures performed in April. The medical team reported his recovery is progressing satisfactorily, as expected, with no complications, and that he continues his regular activities. The procedures included scalp cauterization for actinic keratosis and an injection for right thumb tendinitis.

item.title: Lula vai ao hospital Sírio-Libanês para acompanhamento de procedimentos feitos em abril
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visited the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo on Monday, the 18th, for follow-up on two medical procedures performed in April. According to a hospital statement, Lula shows satisfactory progress with no complications.

item.title: Tebet tem 24%, Marina 23% e Derrite 18% na disputa ao Senado em SP
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) leads the Senate race in São Paulo with 24% voting intention, followed by Marina Silva (Rede) at 23% and Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) at 18%. The results indicate a technical tie among the three candidates, given the 2.67 percentage point margin of error. Conducted by Gerp from May 11–15, 2026, the survey interviewed 1,400 people and is registered with the TSE under SP-06865/2026.

item.title: Além de Neymar: as outras surpresas da convocação de Ancelotti para a Copa
item.description: The Brazilian national team's 2026 World Cup squad, announced by Carlo Ancelotti, featured surprises including Neymar, Endrick, Weverton, Rayan, and Igor Thiago. Players like Weverton and Neymar, despite being 2022 veterans, had never been called up by Ancelotti before. Endrick and Casemiro, who previously disagreed on the young forward's inclusion, will now join forces in the quest for a sixth World Cup title in the United States.

item.title: Nikolas, Simões e mais políticos de direita celebram Neymar na Copa
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) celebrated Neymar’s call-up for the 2026 World Cup with an AI-generated photo showing him alongside the striker. Other right-wing politicians, including state deputy Bruno Engler (PL) and federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG), also voiced support, with Engler sharing a video of Neymar singing a Bolsonaro campaign jingle and Ferreira reposting an old Neymar message about faith. The selection was widely praised by right-wing and far-right figures, including Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who prophesied a 'hexa'.

item.title: Adversário de Joaquim Barbosa no STF se manifesta sobre pré-candidatura
item.description: Former Supreme Court Justice Marco Aurélio Mello commented on Joaquim Barbosa's pre-candidacy for the Presidency of the Republic, calling it a matter of 'foro íntimo' and expressing hope that Barbosa would be happy. When asked about Barbosa's chances of reaching the Planalto Palace, Mello replied 'who knows?', emphasizing the uncertainty of politics. The two former justices had public clashes during their time on the STF, including one over the interruption of pregnancy in cases of anencephalic fetuses.

item.title: Câmara e Senado defendem no STF validade da Lei da Dosimetria
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies and the Senate defended before the STF the validity of the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences for those convicted of the January 8 acts, including Jair Bolsonaro. They argued that the suspension imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes is serious and that Congress has the final say on the presidential veto. Three actions challenge the overturning of Lula’s veto, with a ruling expected this month.

item.title: Senado e Câmara defendem Lei da Dosimetria e pedem rejeição de ações que contestam a legislação
item.description: The Senate and Chamber of Deputies urged the STF to dismiss lawsuits challenging the Dosimetry Law, which reduces sentences for those convicted in the January 8 attacks, including former President Jair Bolsonaro. Congress argues the law reflects legislative will, that there was no irregularity in processing the presidential veto, and that amendments only improved the text without worsening the situation of convicts.

item.title: Saiba as diferenças entre Fundo Partidário e Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: The Party Fund finances the permanent activities of political parties, such as administrative expenses and institutional propaganda, with monthly disbursements from the Union budget, fines, and donations. The Electoral Fund (FEFC), established in 2017, is exclusively for financing electoral campaigns, with resources set in the Annual Budget Law and distributed by the TSE during election years. Both are public, but differ in purpose, disbursement frequency, and usage rules.

item.title: Fim escala 6x1: empresários criticam redução de jornada em ano eleitoral e pedem transição
item.description: Business representatives criticized the rushed debate on reducing the workweek (ending the 6x1 schedule) during an election year, urging a transition period to avoid sudden economic impacts. The Chamber’s special committee heard employer confederations on Monday (18), with worker representatives scheduled for Tuesday (19). Reporter Leo Prates is set to present his report on Wednesday (20), with a vote planned for May 26.

item.title: Deputados de SP enviaram emendas para empresas geridas por sócia de produtora do filme 'Dark Horse'
item.description: São Paulo state deputies, including Bolsonarists and one Petista, allocated R$700k in parliamentary amendments to companies linked to Karina Ferreira da Gama, partner of the producer behind the 'Dark Horse' film about Jair Bolsonaro. Of this, R$300k was disbursed, with contributions from Valéria Bolsonaro, Lucas Bove, and Gil Diniz. The film’s financing is under PF investigation, and the case reflects broader scrutiny of public fund use by Bolsonaro allies.

item.title: Lula passa por check-up no Sírio-Libanês em São Paulo
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent a routine medical check-up at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo to monitor his recovery following skin lesion removal surgery on his scalp in April. The medical bulletin reports satisfactory progress as expected, with no complications, and confirms he continues his normal activities. Prior to the appointment, Lula inaugurated four synchrotron light lines at the Sirius particle accelerator in Campinas and announced Petrobras’ R$ 37 billion investment in São Paulo state through 2030.

item.title: Lula passa por consulta no Sírio-libanês para acompanhar retirada de lesão na cabeça: 'evolução satisfatória'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attended a follow-up consultation at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital to monitor the recovery from the removal of a skin cancer lesion on his scalp, performed last month. The medical bulletin reported satisfactory evolution, as expected, with no complications, clearing him to resume normal activities. Lula also called José Dirceu, who is being treated for lymphoma at the same hospital, expressing confidence in his ally’s recovery.

item.title: Bolsonaristas comemoram convocação de Neymar; Lula silencia sobre seleção
item.description: Bolsonarist lawmakers celebrated Neymar Jr.'s call-up to the Brazilian national team, using the event on social media for political purposes. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, posted a photo beside the footballer holding a framed print of Neymar's footprints. President Lula remained silent on the selection.

item.title: Senado não pode votar Messias neste ano, e reenvio seria gesto político de Lula
item.description: The Senate cannot vote again on Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF in 2026 due to a 2010 rule prohibiting re-examination of a rejected nomination in the same legislative session. If Lula resubmits the name, the vote would only occur in 2027, unless Senate President Davi Alcolumbre changes the rules — seen as unlikely. Resubmitting would be a political gesture by Lula to support his ally, despite the rejection being tied to the 'BolsoMaster' scandal.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Flávio Bolsonaro insiste em associar caso Master a Lula | CNN 360º
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro insists on linking the Master case to Lula, attempting to tie the former president to corruption schemes involving public contracts. The accusation emerges amid investigations into alleged favoritism in public bidding, though no concrete evidence directly ties Lula to the case. The strategy aims to damage Lula's image in the 2026 elections by invoking narratives of morality and fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Com Neymar, elenco convocado para Copa vale R$ 5,32 bi
item.description: The Brazilian squad called up for the 2026 World Cup has a market value of R$ 5.32 billion (€909.7 million), according to Transfermarkt. Neymar returns after 31 months out due to a serious knee injury, having recently felt calf pain in a Santos match. The most valuable players are Vinícius Júnior (€150m), Raphinha (€80m), and Gabriel Magalhães (€75m).

item.title: Que estreia! Neymar e Weverton, convocados para a Copa, nunca haviam sido chamados por Ancelotti
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti revealed Brazil's 26-player squad for the 2026 World Cup at the Museum of Tomorrow. Neymar Jr. of Santos and Weverton of Cruzeiro were included despite never having played under the Italian coach. While Neymar's call-up was expected following his return to Brazilian football in 2025, Weverton's selection surprised many, as he competed for the spot with goalkeepers from top European clubs including Alisson, Bento, Ederson, and Hugo Souza.

item.title: PL diz que “Flávio é Neymar, Neymar é Flávio”
item.description: The PL shared an AI-generated video depicting Flávio Bolsonaro as a Brazilian national team player, with the caption 'Flávio is Neymar. Neymar is Flávio,' hours before the 2026 World Cup squad announcement. The post came amid political debate over Neymar’s potential call-up, given his past support for Jair Bolsonaro in 2022 and his exclusion from Ancelotti’s squads since May 2025. President Lula stated that selection should be based on sporting merit, not fame or political allegiance.

item.title: Fora da lista de Ancelotti, João Pedro defendeu convocação de Neymar para Copa do Mundo: 'É o meu ídolo'
item.description: Chelsea forward João Pedro was left out of Carlo Ancelotti’s final squad for the 2026 World Cup, but publicly defended Neymar’s inclusion, calling him his idol. The 24-year-old said Neymar is as vital to Brazil as Messi is to Argentina, despite never having played alongside him. He also noted that teammate Andrey Santos was another Chelsea player omitted from the Brazil roster.

item.title: A reação de Flávio Bolsonaro à convocação de Neymar para Copa
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro celebrated Neymar's call-up for the 2026 World Cup on social media, stating 'the hexa is coming'. He highlighted his prior support for the player, who had previously endorsed Jair Bolsonaro in 2022. Deputy Hélio Lopes had also formally requested Neymar's inclusion in the CBF roster.

item.title: Neymar na Copa do Mundo escapa da sina de Romário
item.description: The article examines the public pressure for Romário to be selected for the 2002 World Cup, drawing a parallel with recent calls for Neymar in the 2026 tournament, and highlights how the sports selection debate became intertwined with the 2002 presidential election between Lula and Serra. Despite widespread popular support and even endorsement from FHC, coach Felipão did not call up Romário, leading Brazil to a fifth title with Ronaldinho, Ronaldo and Rivaldo.

item.title: Após 68 anos, Flamengo volta a ter quatro jogadores convocados pela seleção brasileira em uma Copa do Mundo
item.description: Flamengo has four players called up to the Brazilian national team for the 2026 World Cup, matching its 1958 record and marking the first time since then. This is the highest representation from a single Brazilian club since São Paulo in 1994, with potential for up to nine Flamengo players across various national teams.

item.title: Escalação de Carlo Ancelotti exclui cinco nomes do álbum da Copa do Mundo
item.description: The Panini 2026 World Cup album for the Brazilian national team features 20 slots, including 18 players, the CBF shield, and the official team photo. Following Carlo Ancelotti's official call-up, five players listed in the album were left out of the final squad, while six others not in the album were selected. The main highlight is Neymar's absence, due to a prolonged lack of call-ups.

item.title: Janja celebra aniversário de casamento com Lula nas redes sociais
item.description: First Lady Rosângela da Silva, known as Janja, celebrated her 4th wedding anniversary with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in an Instagram post, recalling their 2022 ceremony in São Paulo and expressing eternal love. Lula’s official profile replied with a heart emoji.

item.title: Daciolo diz que direita e esquerda são “mesma moeda” no caso Master
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Cabo Daciolo (Mobiliza) accused the political right, left, and center of being 'opposite sides of the same coin' in the Banco Master scandal, calling for a parliamentary inquiry (CPI) into alleged billion-dollar banking fraud. He linked the case to Flávio Bolsonaro’s alleged negotiations with Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro to fund the film 'Dark Horse', involving $24 million in transfers between February and May 2025. Vorcaro and his financial operator have been imprisoned since March 2026 under Operation Compliance Zero, which investigates financial crimes at the bank.

item.title: Indústria diz que críticas à fim da escala 6 X 1 não são “chororô”
item.description: CNI director Alexandre Furlan dismissed criticisms of the proposed reduction in working hours as 'businessman's whining,' stating that industry concerns are economic and sector-specific, particularly for continuous-operation industries like steel and ceramics. He argued that reducing work hours without productivity gains increases costs for businesses and consumers, and advocated for sustainable reductions driven by productivity improvements through education, professional training, innovation, and legal security — not political mandates.

item.title: Neymar convocado para a Copa do Mundo: relembre último jogo do atacante pela seleção brasileira
item.description: Neymar has been called up to the Brazilian national team for the first time since 2023 for the 2026 World Cup, under coach Carlo Ancelotti. His last appearance for Brazil was on October 17, 2023, when he suffered a serious left knee injury against Uruguay, keeping him out of action for over a year. With 128 caps, 79 goals, and 58 assists, this will be his fourth World Cup appearance.

item.title: Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro podem entrar em inquérito do STF?
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) formally requested the STF and Federal Police to include Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former president Jair Bolsonaro in investigations into alleged coercion and obstruction of justice involving former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro. The move aims to broaden the scope of ongoing probes targeting the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Imprensa internacional repercute convocação da seleção brasileira e presença de Neymar na Copa: 'Surpresa mundial'
item.description: The announcement of Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad by Carlo Ancelotti sparked global media attention, particularly due to Neymar's inclusion, which was labeled a 'worldwide surprise' by Spanish and Portuguese outlets. The omission of Thiago Silva was also noted, while Ancelotti's arrival was likened to a rockstar by Spanish media.

item.title: Confira a lista de convocados do Brasil para a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Coach Carlo Ancelotti has named 26 players for Brazil's squad at the 2026 World Cup, to be held in Mexico, Canada, and the United States from June 11 to July 19. Neymar Jr. was included, marking his fourth consecutive World Cup appearance and tying Pelé's record by wearing the number 10 shirt. The selection features nine forwards, five midfielders, and a mix of defenders and goalkeepers, including prominent European-based players and Neymar's return via Santos.

item.title: Com Neymar, Ancelotti divulga a lista de convocados do Brasil para a Copa; veja a relação
item.description: Coach Carlo Ancelotti announced Brazil's 26-player roster for the 2026 World Cup, including Neymar despite his recent injuries and absence since October 2023. An ESPM-SP poll shows fan division over Neymar's call-up, reflecting off-field influences on public opinion.

item.title: Neymar vai para a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Neymar Jr. has been named in Brazil's final 26-player squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, ending months of uncertainty about his participation. The announcement was made by head coach Carlo Ancelotti at the Museum of Tomorrow in Rio de Janeiro. The tournament will be jointly hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

item.title: Neymar é convocado por Ancelotti para Copa do Mundo
item.description: Neymar has been called up by Carlo Ancelotti for the 2026 World Cup, marking his fourth consecutive appearance and nearing Pelé’s record by wearing the number 10 shirt. The announcement ended speculation over Brazil’s final squad, which will face Morocco, Haiti, and Scotland in Group C across venues in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. The selection underscores Neymar’s enduring central role despite past injuries and tournament disappointments.

item.title: Convocado por Ancelotti, Neymar terá 'last dance' com a seleção nos EUA depois de dividir novamente o Brasil
item.description: Neymar has been officially called up by Carlo Ancelotti for the 2026 World Cup in the USA, Mexico, and Canada, marking his fourth World Cup appearance at age 34. Despite recurring injuries and public polarization due to his political stances and social media presence, he remains Brazil’s all-time leading scorer and a central figure in the team’s campaign, whether starting or coming off the bench.

item.title: Neymar entra em seleta lista de brasileiros convocados para quatro Copas do Mundo: são apenas nove jogadores
item.description: Neymar has been called up for the 2026 World Cup, becoming the ninth Brazilian player to feature in four editions of the tournament. He joins legends such as Pelé, Djalma Santos, Castilho, Nilton Santos, Cafu, Ronaldo, Emerson Leão and Thiago Silva, who also participated in four or more World Cups.

item.title: Dino relata ameaça de funcionária de companhia aérea e pede campanhas de educação cívica de empresas
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino reported being threatened with death by an airline employee during boarding after she recognized his name on the boarding pass. He linked the incident to rising political radicalization ahead of the 2026 elections and urged companies to implement civic education campaigns to ensure peaceful coexistence and safety in public services.

item.title: Endrick é convocado para jogar na Copa de 2026 pela Seleção Brasileira
item.description: Endrick, an 18-year-old Brazilian forward, has been called up for the first time to the Brazil national team for the 2026 World Cup. He was on loan at Lyon but will return to Real Madrid ahead of the official announcement by the CBF on Monday (May 18). Endrick has progressed through Brazil’s youth teams (U-17, U-20, U-23) and received his first senior call-up in 2023.

item.title: O grande desafio de Lula na área que mais preocupa o eleitor
item.description: The Lula government launched the Brazil Against Organized Crime program with R$11 billion in investments to strengthen public security, initially focusing on the Amazon and border regions. However, experts doubt the initiative will yield electoral benefits before the 2026 elections, as implementation takes time and fear of violence remains a decisive factor for voters.

item.title: Bancada do PL protocola convite para PF explicar troca de delegado no inquérito das fraudes no INSS
item.description: The leader of the PL caucus in the Chamber, Sóstenes Cavalcante, filed a request inviting the Federal Police director-general, Andrei Rodrigues, to explain the replacement of the delegate in the INSS fraud investigation, which targets President Lula’s son and businessman Antônio Camilo Antunes. The opposition alleges government interference in PF autonomy, claiming the change occurred at a critical moment, right after a bank secrecy waiver request for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva. STF Minister André Mendonça also sought explanations, stating he was not informed prior to the change.

item.title: Damares aciona TCU por prejuízo de R$ 260 mi com vacinas vencidas
item.description: Senator Damares Alves has submitted an official request to the TCU for full access to an audit concerning the waste of over R$260 million in expired Coronavac vaccines purchased in 2023 under the Lula administration. The audit attributes the loss to delays in procurement by the Health Ministry, which resulted in 8 million of 10 million doses expiring and being incinerated. The government claims it inherited a state of complete abandonment of vaccine stocks from the Bolsonaro administration.

item.title: Carlo Ancelotti convoca a Seleção Brasileira para a Copa do Mundo. Siga ao vivo no YouTube
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti announced Brazil's 26-player squad for the 2026 World Cup at a special event at the Museu do Amanhã in Rio de Janeiro. The team is placed in Group C and will open its campaign against Morocco on June 13 at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. Attention is focused on whether Neymar, not called up since 2023, will make the list, while Danilo and Vinícius Júnior have already been confirmed by the coach.

item.title: Lula quer explorar petróleo na Margem Equatorial contra domínio de Trump
item.description: President Lula announced that Brazil will explore oil in the Equatorial Margin to prevent Donald Trump from claiming the region as his own, stating the exploration will be conducted with the utmost responsibility and profits used to subsidize fuels and secure the nation's future. He also blamed Trump for the Iran war and explained that the government is using Petrobras' extra profits from rising oil prices due to the conflict to subsidize gasoline and diesel, shielding Brazilian consumers from price hikes.
